name: Entropy

subjectOf.text: The automated maintenance system is the UDLC's primary defense against the entropy that has rendered every previous attempt at universal private law either rigid or irrelevant.
subjectOf.abstract: Far from a mere cleanup routine, the automated maintenance system constitutes the UDLC's primary defense against the entropy that has rendered every previous attempt at universal private law either rigid or irrelevant.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The UDLC DAO Operationalizing a Continuously Evolving Universal Digital Law Codex Through Weighted (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5887242

subjectOf.text: Filters that select on surprise or entropy, not validity, work where they work because they see what a validity filter is forbidden to see, and against that literature a null here is a literature rather than a caveat.
subjectOf.abstract: Intelligence models increasingly learn from data that earlier Intelligence models produced, and when that loop repeats the rare cases disappear first. This paper preregisters a test of whether a reputation-weighted validator pool, filtering the training data of a recursive replacement loop, keeps those rare cases alive. The outcomes remain sealed until a replication of the original model-collapse result succeeds.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Can Reputation Prevent Model Collapse? A Preregistered Test of Reputation-Weighted Data Filtering (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7598518
scope_conditions: The comparison rests on published surprise-filter and entropy-filter results.
The paper runs no surprise or entropy arm, so it supplies no measured comparison with them.
